findings.problem: The OpenAPI numeric bounds are emitted as JSON strings. `Minimum = "1"` and `Maximum = PageRequest.MaxPageSize.ToString(...)` assign string nodes to `OpenApiSchema.Minimum`/`Maximum`, which are `JsonNode` properties. The generated specification therefore contains string bounds instead of numbers.
findings.fix: Use numeric values: `Minimum = JsonValue.Create(PageRequest.FirstPage)` and `Maximum = name == "page_size" ? JsonValue.Create(PageRequest.MaxPageSize) : null`. Remove the now-unused `System.Globalization` import.

conclusion: One actionable standards finding; no other concrete correctness or security violations were found in the supplied text.
